endorsements.name: Keniver Wang
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-11064
endorsements.description: A vulnerability of remote credential disclosure was discovered in Advan VD-1 firmware versions up to 230. An attacker can export system configuration which is not encrypted to get the administrator’s account and password in plain text via cgibin/ExportSettings.cgi?Export=1 without any authentication.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Keniver Wang
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-13405
endorsements.description: A broken access control vulnerability found in Advan VD-1 firmware version 230 leads to insecure ADB service. An attacker can send a POST request to cgibin/AdbSetting.cgi to enable ADB without any authentication then take the compromised device as a relay or to install mining software.
